title: A Noetherian ring has finitely many minimal primes
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Then $R$ has only finitely many minimal prime ideals (prime ideals $\mathfrak q\subset R$ containing no strictly smaller prime ideal); equivalently $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] has finitely many irreducible components.
